A '''Med tracer''' was a medical device that allowed wounded [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to be found and rescued on the battlefield. In [[3640 BBY]] during the [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|battle]] of [[Kalandis Seven]] [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Amden vor Keioidian]] was fatally wounded and his med tracer was activated by his [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad leader]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]].

==Behind the scenes==
Med tracers first appeared in [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story ''[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]'' which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]] and released on [[October 23]], [[2012]].
